events.body:
## Summary

Document how BLT-Jobs can stay portable across Git-compatible hosting platforms while GitLab remains the first polished implementation.

## Scope

- Forking and mirroring model.
- Upstream sync and conflict resolution.
- GitHub issue/PR readiness plan.
- Generic Git-compatible provider path.
- Contributor and maintainer docs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add docs explaining how forks/mirrors can contribute jobs/profiles upstream.
- [ ] Document how a company could maintain jobs in its own repo and submit upstream changes.
- [ ] Define GitHub support as a provider roadmap without blocking GitLab-first work.
- [ ] Document local development, validation, and submission processing for contributors.
- [ ] Keep docs human-first and concise; detailed implementation notes can live in this docs plan.
